description.value:
Cereans are a tall, slender species distinguished by their elongated, conical skulls, which house a secondary heart and a binary brain capable of processing information in parallel. This unusual physiology grants Cereans exceptional patience, foresight, and a natural talent for logic and strategy.

Cereans favor careful deliberation over hasty action, and many serve as scholars, tacticians, and diplomats where their measured thinking is most valued.

traits.name: Binary Processing
traits.description: Your dual brain lets you weigh multiple lines of reasoning simultaneously. You have advantage on Intelligence checks made to solve puzzles, plan strategy, or otherwise reason through a complex problem given at least one minute to think.

traits.name: Secondary Heart
traits.description: Your secondary heart provides redundant circulation. You have advantage on saving throws against being reduced to 0 hit points by a single attack, and against effects that would cause you to suffer a level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Foresight
traits.description: Your careful, deliberate mind rarely misses a threat. You have advantage on initiative checks.
